Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
Sponsor: Hurst
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 145 as introduced would increase the expenditures of the Secretary of State by an estimated $100,000 per statewide election cycle for a system that provides for absentee voting by blind or visually-impaired voters. Also, this bill would increase the obligations of the Alabama Institute for Deaf and Blind by an undetermined amount to provide an affidavit confirming an individual is blind or visually impaired to vote absentee pursuant to this bill.
Bob Fincher, Chair
Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
